edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: 24s at rank 1, 16s max — the ground lasts moments, the downtime lasts most of half a minute, and that downtime is your all-in window. - Her Twin Fang is a 0.75s spammable that heals her off poisoned targets — anti-heal before extended trades.
